categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: aviation engines and derivative products, foreign trade export subcontracting, and non-aviation products and other businesses. It manufactures, sells, and services aviation engines and gas turbines, provides maintenance and repair services, and produces aerospace engine components for domestic and international markets. The company also develops high value-added products related to aviation engine technologies, such as industrial equipment and industrial properties.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of a full spectrum of military aviation engines including turbojet, turbofan, turboshaft, turboprop, and piston engines. It employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as additive manufacturing, coating technologies, precision high-efficiency machining, and digital and intelligent manufacturing processes. The company has established a comprehensive technology innovation system with multiple national and provincial innovation centers and collaborates extensively with academic and research institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military aircraft manufacturers and naval shipbuilders, as well as international aerospace engine manufacturers such as SAFRAN, Rolls-Royce, GE Aerospace, and others. The company serves both military and civil aviation sectors, with expanding presence in domestic commercial aviation, general aviation, and low-altitude economy markets. It also supplies components for major international civil engines like GE9X, CFM56, LEAP-1A/B, and Trent series.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with major facilities in Xi'an, Shenyang, Guizhou, and Hunan provinces. It also has international cooperation and export activities, serving global aerospace manufacturers and markets. Its foreign trade export subcontracting business involves supplying components to international clients in Europe, the United States, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the full aviation engine industry chain, including research and development, production, testing, sales, and after-sales service. It is positioned as a midstream to upstream manufacturer and service provider, covering design, manufacturing, assembly, testing, and maintenance of engines and components. It also engages in subcontracted manufacturing for foreign aerospace companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating the development and batch production of new generation aviation engines, enhancing digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities, and expanding into civil and general aviation markets. The company emphasizes innovation in new materials, new processes, and new technologies, with a focus on additive manufacturing and advanced coatings. It also aims to strengthen its talent pool, optimize management processes, and improve supply chain resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aviation engines and derivative products, subcontracted manufacturing of engine components for foreign clients, and provision of maintenance and repair services. The company also earns income from non-aviation product sales and government subsidies. Revenue recognition follows contract-based delivery and service completion milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the only domestic enterprise capable of independently developing a full range of military aviation engines and is among a few globally with such capabilities. It holds a leading position in China's aviation engine industry and maintains strategic partnerships with major international aerospace manufacturers. Its competitive advantages lie in its comprehensive product portfolio, technological innovation, and government support.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 47.88 billion, a 9.48% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 860 million, reflecting a 39.48% decrease mainly due to increased R&D and financial expenses. Total assets grew by 16.15% to RMB 115.91 billion. The company maintains a strong asset base and continues to invest heavily in R&D and fixed assets to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique capability to develop and manufacture a full spectrum of military aviation engines domestically, ensuring national strategic security. It offers comprehensive lifecycle services from design to maintenance, leveraging advanced manufacturing technologies and a robust innovation ecosystem. Its products are characterized by high technical integration, reliability, and alignment with both military and civil aviation needs, differentiating it from competitors.
